<quote by="Announced by Ada Droon, Mistress of Monuments">As Mistress of Monuments, I propose an edifice in Broken Rise, Reikos. This engraved white granite pillar would celebrate the Silent Bell sodality for their tireless work in defending the Empire and the Way. This will be fully funded by Anatolij Paukov Zorkin
</quote>
